messages:
Lina: Quick final check for SEO handoff before webinar launch in 24h — need keywords for hero + FAQ, redirect plan for legacy promos, JSON-LD (Event+FAQ), internal anchor recommendations, and UTMs for lead routing. Who picks what?
Omar: I'll own keywords + anchor copy. Proposal: primary KWs: 'inference reliability for LLMs', 'edge LLM deployment'; support: 'reducing LLM latency', 'LLM batching best practices', 'cost-efficient LLM serving'.
Chloe: I'll handle redirects/canonical. Two legacy paths: /promo/alpha-2025 and /legacy/webinar-edge. We'll 301 -> /webinars/serving-inference. No JS redirects.
Omar: Hero H1 suggestion: "Reliable, Cost-Effective LLM Inference"
Omar: FAQ longtails examples: 'how to improve LLM inference reliability', 'best practices for LLM batching and caching'
Chloe: Nginx redirect snippet (for infra PR):
```
# canonicalize legacy promo pages to webinar landing
location = /promo/alpha-2025 {
  return 301 /webinars/serving-inference;
}
location ^~ /legacy/webinar-edge/ {
  rewrite ^/legacy/webinar-edge/(.*)$ /webinars/serving-inference permanent;
}
```
Chloe: Canonical tag: landing -> self; legacy pages -> 301. Noindex only if page is archival and we explicitly want it out.
Lina: Internal linking matrix: Product overview -> Performance benchmarks -> Webinar landing -> Integration docs. Anchor text suggestions: 'inference reliability', 'throughput benchmarks', 'register for webinar', 'integration guide'.
Omar: JSON-LD Event (paste in head):
```
{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Event","name":"Redwood Inference Webinar: Serving LLMs Reliably","startDate":"2026-06-30T17:00:00Z","location":{"@type":"VirtualLocation","url":"https://redwood.ai/webinars/serving-inference"},"organizer":{"@type":"Organization","name":"Redwood Inference"}}
```
Omar: JSON-LD FAQ snippet (for 3 main Qs), include in CMS where FAQ is rendered.
Lina: UTM plan for channels: utm_source=redwood, utm_medium=email|social|partner, utm_campaign=webinar_serving_inference_jun2026. salesops to map utm_campaign -> CRM field 'campaign_code'.
salesops: Confirmed. We'll route webinar leads with campaign_code=webinar_serving_inference_jun2026 to Pipeline: SDR-Webinars. Also capturing utm_content for creative variant.
infra-bot: site-scan: detected 7 pages missing Event or FAQ schema; recommend adding JSON-LD to landing and related promos.
Chloe: Action list: I'll open infra PR for redirects and tag infra.
Omar: I'll push KW + hero copy to CMS and add FAQ longtail Qs.
Lina: I'll update the internal-linking doc and share final anchor table. Can we get PR + CMS changes by 14:30 PT?
Chloe: PR open, pinging infra.
Omar: Hero + FAQ uploaded.
salesops: CRM mapping done.
Lina: Great — thanks all. Please post deploy confirmation in this thread. :thumbsup:
